dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular and interconnected light-toned O-shaped perimeters on the anterior-dorsal surface; edges display a sharp contrast transition from a dark gray exterior to a lighter interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, small light-intensity pixel clusters situated primarily in the transition zone between the patterned mid-section and the solid dark neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a wide scalene triangle on the upper flank, with smaller secondary blobs forming a roughly linear path towards the posterior taper.
